result.document_summary: A part of the San Diego Municipal Code (code-publisher page) containing the tail of the Earned Sick Leave division and the Traffic Control Worker Minimum Wage Ordinance (Ch. 3, Art. 10), plus headings for a grocery pricing article; no residential rental rules appear in this part.
result.notes: Although the page URL references San Diego Municipal Code section 98.1103 (algorithmic rent price-fixing), the text in this part contains only labor and wage provisions (earned sick leave severability, traffic control worker minimum wage) and grocery-pricing headings.
